name: 1540s controlled place geography: seven old references + Wales law overlay + five schematic fort/city vicinities

metadata.render_safety: Draw uncertain outlines DASHED; narrative says symbolic vicinity not historical borders. Never sum any polygon area as military control. English Scottish occupations are local bases within independent Kingdom of Scotland, not country annexation.
metadata.reminder: All five older approximate garrison circles and two new Ambleteuse/Boulemberg circles are schematic radius-only, not 1540s authenticated border polygons.
